[[File:Carand.png|thumb|Sign of House Carand|alt=Three golden arrows pointing upwards (with the middle arrow slightly raised) on a red background]]'''House Carand''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. The [[High Seat]] is [[Aemlyn Carand]], whose husband is [[Culhan Carand]].

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Carand consists of three golden arrows. The Companion describes Aemlyn's sigil as three golden arrows pointing upwards (with the middle arrow slightly raised) on a red background. These may be the same sigils or slightly different.{{ref/book|twotc}}

==Activities==
During the [[Third Succession War]], House Carand supported [[House Trakand]] gaining the [[Lion Throne]].

House Carand was among the three great Houses that met with the [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Egwene]] in [[Murandy]]{{ref/book|8|17}}.

During the [[Fourth Succession War]], House Carand was initially among the six neutral great Houses that stayed apart during the [[Fourth Succession War|Siege of Caemlyn]]{{ref/book|11|17}}.

After the Siege of Caemlyn House Carand supported [[Elayne Trakand]] due to [[Dyelin Taravin]]'s speech in her favour{{ref/book|11|35}}.
